name: Crème Brûlée
description: A silky vanilla baked custard chilled until set, then torched with sugar into a crackling caramel crust.
ingredients: a pinch of cracked black peppercorns
a handful of fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with extra-virgin olive oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the baguette and fresh thyme until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the Dijon mustard with the chicken stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 45 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: Bring your Dijon mustard to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
